units: US$ millions, except per-share figures, shares (millions) and rates

sources.offer_price_per_share: CRH press release, 22 Jun 2026: all-cash, $150 per share, ~$8.5bn enterprise value, close expected Q1 2027
sources.synergies_pre_tax: CRH deal presentation, 22 Jun 2026: ~$175m run-rate cost synergies by year 3; phasing chart ~$60m, ~$130m, ~$175m
sources.extra_amortisation_pre_tax: Assumption: extra yearly amortisation from revaluing Arcosa's assets at the deal price. Not disclosed, so 0 in the base case; see sensitivity table 3
sources.acquirer.net_income: CRH FY2026 guidance (FY2025 results, Feb 2026): net income $3.9-4.1bn, midpoint
sources.acquirer.diluted_shares: CRH FY2025 weighted average diluted shares, 677.0m
sources.acquirer.share_price: CRH closing price on 9 Oct 2026, $81.54 (only used if part of the price is paid in shares)
sources.acquirer.tax_rate: CRH FY2025 income tax $1,041m / pre-tax income $4,805m
sources.target.net_income: Arcosa FY2026 guidance (Q1 2026 results): income from continuing operations $200.4-218.6m, midpoint
sources.target.diluted_shares: Arcosa Q1 2026 weighted average diluted shares, 49.2m
sources.target.net_debt: Arcosa net debt at 31 Mar 2026, pro forma for the barge business sale ($1,012.8m)
sources.target.interest_expense: Arcosa FY2026 guidance: net interest expense $79-81m, midpoint (removed when CRH repays Arcosa's debt)
sources.target.adjusted_ebitda: Arcosa FY2026 guidance midpoint used in CRH's deal presentation, $565m
sources.financing.cash_used: Assumption. CRH said it will pay with 'available cash and committed debt financing' but gave no split; CRH had $4.1bn of cash at end-2025
sources.financing.cost_of_new_debt: Assumption: 5.0%, the coupon on CRH's 10-year notes issued Oct 2025
sources.financing.interest_rate_on_cash: Assumption: about CRH's FY2025 interest income ($146m) divided by year-end cash ($4.1bn)
